user_direction: Always compare alternatives against our planned NI setup. NI USB-6361 remains the reference for subsequent component comparisons; it is not assumed owned or fully configured.
purpose: Price the EMM-6 and M50, identify a lower-cost calibrated 32kHz measurement candidate and explain its connection/timing differences against NI.

reference_NI_measurement_path.path: Earthworks M50 -> Sound Devices MM-1 phantom power and microphone preamp -> NI USB-6361 analog input -> computer
reference_NI_measurement_path.status: Proposed measurement addition; not microphone hardware identified in the SONIC paper. No assembled performance is measured.
reference_NI_measurement_path.subtotal_exclusions: NI DAQ, calibration reference, cables/adapters, stand, batteries, tax, shipping and labor.
reference_NI_measurement_path.NI_role: NI generates the stimulus and can acquire the conditioned microphone signal and electrical reference with configured hardware timing. Neural recorder markers/clock compatibility remain to be confirmed.
reference_NI_measurement_path.power_dependency: The NI alone does not provide XLR microphone phantom power or the MM-1's microphone preamplification.

microphones.connection: Analog XLR, phantom-powered; a suitable preamp/conditioning stage is required before NI analog input.
microphones.32kHz_assessment: Outside the specified range; not selected as the reference for 32kHz measurements.
microphones.retrieval: Price and stock recovered via retailer product/catalog search text; direct product retrieval intermittently returns an empty page.

microphones.observed_availability: In stock on retrieved new-item page, unreserved
microphones.calibration: Printed unit response and downloadable individual electronic calibration file.
microphones.connection: Analog XLR; manufacturer specifies 24-48V phantom, 10mA. MM-1 supplies power/gain and line output to NI in our reference proposal.
microphones.32kHz_assessment: Inside published microphone band; complete chain and reference-position uncertainty require verification.
microphones.manufacturer_document_conflict: Current product page gives 65ohm balanced output and 600ohm minimum load; official May2022 PDF p4 explicitly labels output impedance600ohm. Historical notes followed that PDF. Confirm exact revision rather than treating either statement as an assembled measurement.

microphones.price_scope: Measurement package; manufacturer lists microphone, PhotoLink, test leads, USB cable, compact stand, clip and case. No separate MM-1 in this USB path.
microphones.observed_availability: In stock in retrieved retailer catalog; no reservation or checkout. Direct retailer product page unavailable in this audit.
microphones.manufacturer_accuracy_wording: Calibrated frequency-response shape is normally within2dB across5Hz-40kHz. Absolute sensitivity is treated separately; this is not a guaranteed assembled absolute SPL uncertainty. Manual PDFpp84-85.
microphones.calibration: Unit-specific frequency and sensitivity data; software manual describes .omm file, while product page also advertises serialized .txt data. Confirm supplied formats before third-party use.
microphones.connection: USB with integrated ADC, 96000samples/s; connects to computer separately from NI.
microphones.software: Bundled workflow recommends Windows10/11; reliable Mac/Linux or third-party raw capture remains unverified. Manual PDFp81.
microphones.sync_limit: PhotoLink timing applies to sine-sweep FrequencyResponse mode, not general 10ms-pip/neural alignment. Manual PDFp9.
microphones.32kHz_assessment: Documented lower-cost candidate for bench level/frequency calibration alongside NI playback. Not a direct replacement for the NI analog microphone input or a validated continuous arbitrary-tone recorder.
microphones.harmonic_limit: A40kHz measurement ceiling cannot capture the64kHz second harmonic of a32kHz tone; do not claim complete32kHz THD characterization with this device.
microphones.budget_comparison: 499.98USD measurement package versus2244USD M50+MM1 subtotal, with different acquisition/synchronization capabilities.

MM1_price_and_specs.spec_scope: Mic-to-line response specified -1dB at50kHz relative to1kHz with150ohm source; 48V phantom can supply10mA. Verify gain, clipping, filter/limiter state and assembled response.

screened_alternatives.reason: Primary range10Hz-20kHz; not established for calibrated32kHz use.
Nominal30kHz upper range does not establish32kHz measurement.

USB ultrasound recorder candidate, but retrieved product information did not establish unit-specific calibrated absolute32kHz sound level. Detecting ultrasound is distinct from calibrated measurement.

Analog ultrasound candidate requiring48V10mA conditioning; relative response compensation is shown, but unit-specific32kHz reference calibration was not established in this audit. Adding the same945USD preamp yields1785USD before NI/accessories.

recommendation_scope: Evaluate OmniMic40k as the lower-cost calibration tool, retaining NI as the stimulus/timing reference. For continuous acoustic waveforms acquired directly in NI, the M50+MM1 path remains our comparison baseline; cheaper calibrated analog substitutes were not qualified here. Its response-shape claim does not certify true cross-frequency matching within1dB, and M50 bandwidth/ECF likewise does not prove assembled absolute SPL accuracy. Both require actual setup verification.
actions: Public-source research and project documentation only; no order, vendor contact, hardware connection or experiment. Historical PDFs and price snapshots remain unchanged.
